senses.gloss:
ड 1. ड, the third letter of the cerebral
class of consonants, having much the sound of द् in
drum, but properly pronounced by keeping back the
tip of the tongue and slightly turning it upwards. In
Bengal ड् is often confounded in pronunciation with a
hard र्.
—ड-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ड्.
